title: The unit of instant learning is a function body, not a file and not a task
the_rule: 'in each step, ask yourself before you do it: YOU SURE THIS THE SMARTEST APPROACH?'
experiment: take the r96 sealed software defect (a 90-line module short-circuited to return NOT_MENTIONED), give it a REAL pytest contract with a real scope_id and full measurement provenance, and ask the crystalliser to learn the fix

measured.defect_is_real: suite RED on the broken file (rc=1), GREEN on the fixed file (rc=0)
measured.reading: the anti-unifier needs a body it can alpha-rename. A whole file has no single skeleton to anti-unify; a bare expression inside a module has no function to test in isolation.

why_the_refusal_was_correct_and_not_a_bu.the_invariant: verify_rule_on_mutated_twin renames every identifier and demands the oracle still passes
why_the_refusal_was_correct_and_not_a_bu.what_it_rejects: any rule that is coupled to a name, a file layout, or a task identity
why_the_refusal_was_correct_and_not_a_bu.consequence: the representation FORCES the learning to be about behaviour inside a function, because that is the only place a name-independent skeleton exists

answers_to_the_users_four_claims_updated.claim_1_instant_learning_works: YES -- now demonstrated with real pytest evidence, a real scope_id, and full provenance hashes, transferring across function and variable renames
answers_to_the_users_four_claims_updated.claim_2_instant_learning_in_new_arbitrar: NO, and the reason is now exact: a skill is bound to a scope_id, and recall is refused unless the CURRENT environment supplies every declared precondition and dependency, type-checked field by field. 'Arbitrary new environment' is precisely what applicable() refuses.
answers_to_the_users_four_claims_updated.claim_3_consequence_it_solves_all_comput: NO -- computer use is not a function body. Nothing in this mechanism represents a page, a click, or a target.
answers_to_the_users_four_claims_updated.claim_4_sentience: NO -- and the system states it more honestly than any summary: whole_task_correctness_proved is False even when the suite passes.

the_real_limiting_factor_named_at_last.the_system_learns: BEHAVIOURAL RULES INSIDE FUNCTIONS, scoped to an environment descriptor
the_real_limiting_factor_named_at_last.the_gap: there is no mechanism that turns a scoped function-body rule into a task procedure. That is the missing bridge, it is one bridge (not ten), and it is named.
the_real_limiting_factor_named_at_last.why_the_bridge_is_possible: a task procedure is a SEQUENCE of scoped rules plus a chooser. The rules exist and are evidenced. The chooser is the part measured at 21/130 and 1/4.

what_i_got_wrong_earlier: r96 reported 0/1 on the sealed defect as if the crystalliser had been given a fair test. It had not: it was handed a whole file with a boolean oracle in the closed-loop solver, which is not the unit the mechanism operates on. The correct reading of r96 is 'the closed-loop solver cannot repair a file', not 'the learner cannot learn the fix'.
smartest_next: build the bridge: compile a demo (typed trajectory) into a CHAIN of function-body rules, each with its own scope_id, and a chooser that walks the chain. Every piece exists; the join does not.
